mappings.note: Algebra and inspection agree because the balance is uniquely determined up to a multiple -- a property of the balancing procedure, LO-1.

Keeping an atom tally when balancing eight species -- a balancing technique, LO-1.

Why the convention demands the smallest whole-number set -- a requirement of a properly balanced equation, LO-1.
An equation balanced at 1,1,1,1 is simply already balanced. A balance judgement, LO-1.
That inspection always succeeds shows atoms are conserved and merely rearranged -- an inference about conservation of mass, so LO-2 rather than the procedural LO-1 items around it.
